item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00331","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C09","C14","C21"],"selected_candidate_label":"C09","confidence":0.99,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C09 supplies nearly the entire substantive drafting template: the same statutory definition is quoted, the same Treasury finding after notice and hearing is recited, and the operative clause proclaims the finding and makes it immediately effective in the public interest. The child adapts this machinery from seven named drugs to NU-2206. C14 and C21 are also very close single-drug precedents, but C09 is the most recent and its wording most closely matches the child's repeated use of both “addition-forming and addition-sustaining.”","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"Whereas section 3228(f) of the Internal Revenue Code provides in part as follows: “Opiate. The word 'opiate' ... shall mean any drug ... found by the Secretary of the Treasury, after due notice and opportunity for public hearing, to have an addition-forming or addition-sustaining liability similar to morphine or cocaine, and proclaimed by the president to have been so found by the Secretary.”","parent_excerpt":"Whereas section 3228(f) of the Internal Revenue Code provides in part as follow: Opiate. The word “opiate,” ... shall mean any drug ... found by the Secretary of the Treasury, after due notice and opportunity for public hearing, to have an addiction-forming or addiction-sustaining liability similar to morphine or cocaine, and proclaimed by the President to have been so found by the Secretary.","explanation":"The child reproduces the same statutory quotation and predicate machinery, with only minor transcription and spelling variation."},{"child_excerpt":"And Whereas the Secretary of the Treasury, after due notice and opportunity for public hearing, has found the drug NU-2206 ... to have an addition-forming and addition-sustaining liability similar to morphine, and that in the public interest this finding should be effective immediately","parent_excerpt":"And Whereas the Secretary of the Treasury, after due notice and opportunity for public hearing, has found that each of the following named drugs and their salts has addition-forming or addition-sustaining liability similar to morphine, and that in the public interest this finding should be effective immediately","explanation":"The factual recital follows the same distinctive sequence and language, substituting one newly identified drug for the parent's list."},{"child_excerpt":"do hereby proclaim that the Secretary of the Treasury has found the drug NU-2206 ... to have an addition-forming and addition-sustaining liability similar to morphine, and that in the public interest this finding should be effective immediately.","parent_excerpt":"do hereby proclaim that the Secretary of the Treasury has found that each of the aforementioned drugs and their salts has an addition-forming and addition-sustaining liability similar to morphine, and that in the public interest this finding should be effective immediately.","explanation":"The operative proclamation is materially identical in structure and wording, adapted from multiple drugs to NU-2206."}]}
